fusions.name: Bring Down the Pillars
fusions.desc: Heaves for 1.5 seconds, then deals 36 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour, and pins each of them for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Your braided lash deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Mane
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (60% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
